steps.title: Count K562 cells
steps.instruction: Take a 24–48 h old T‑75 flask of K562 cells and determine cell concentration using the Countess 3 automated cell counter (ThermoFisher Scientific).

steps.title: Prepare cell suspension for seeding
steps.instruction: Adjust the cell suspension in 10 % RPMI medium so that 60 µL contains 2 × 10⁴ cells per well, then dispense the suspension into ten 2 mL snap‑capped tubes (≈225 µL per tube) and place the tubes in Slot 6 of the OT‑2 tube rack.

steps.title: Add cells to assay plate
steps.instruction: Dispense the appropriate volume of the cell suspension from the tubes into a 96‑well plate (triplicate wells per concentration) to achieve 2 × 10⁴ cells per well.

steps.title: Prepare bortezomib stock solutions
steps.instruction: In Slot 7, load tube A1 with 30 µL of 10 mM bortezomib. Prepare additional stock tubes with the following concentrations in RPMI: A2 = 1000 µM, A3 = 100 µM, A4 = 10 µM, A5 = 1 µM, A6 = 100 nM, B1 = 10 nM, B2 = 1 nM.

steps.title: Prepare 4× bortezomib working solutions
steps.instruction: Create 4× working solutions in tubes C1‑C6 and D1‑D3 with the following concentrations: C1 = 0.4 nM, C2 = 4 nM, C3 = 40 nM, C4 = 159.2 nM, C5 = 200 nM, C6 = 280 nM, D1 = 400 nM, D2 = 158.95 × 4 nM (≈635.8 nM), D3 = 630.95 × 4 nM (≈2523.8 nM).

steps.title: Perform serial dilutions
steps.instruction: Add RPMI diluent to each stock tube, then transfer the required volume of bortezomib to the next adjacent tube to achieve the target concentration, mixing each tube by pipetting up‑and‑down 3–4 times before aspirating.

steps.title: Add 4× drug to cells
steps.instruction: Add the appropriate 4× bortezomib working solution to each cell‑containing tube (Slot 7) so that the final drug concentration in the tube becomes 1× after mixing.

steps.title: Dispense cell‑drug mixtures to plate
steps.instruction: Mix each cell‑drug tube several times, then dispense the mixture into the 96‑well plate in triplicate. Plate layout: A1, B1, C1 – control cells; D1, E1, F1 – 0.1 nM bortezomib; D4, E4, F4 – 630.95 nM bortezomib; A5‑C5 – medium‑only (no cells).

steps.title: Add CellTox Green reagent
steps.instruction: Using a 20 µL tip from Slot 10, transfer 15 µL of CellTox Green reagent from its source tube to each well of the plate.

steps.title: Shake plate for CellTox incubation
steps.instruction: Place the plate on the Heater‑Shaker module and orbital‑shake for 2 min at 500 rpm.

steps.title: Incubate CellTox plate
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate at room temperature for 15 min.

steps.title: Read CellTox fluorescence
steps.instruction: Read fluorescence on a Biotek microplate reader using 485 nm excitation and 520 nm emission.

steps.title: Add CellTiter‑Glo reagent
steps.instruction: Pick up a 200 µL tip from Slot 4, aspirate 80 µL of CellTiter‑Glo 2.0 reagent from B1 of the Opentrons 10‑tube rack, and dispense into wells A1, B1‑H1, A2‑H2, A3‑H3, A4‑F4, and A5‑C5 of the 96‑well white TC plate on the Heater‑Shaker module.

steps.title: Shake and incubate CellTiter‑Glo
steps.instruction: Orbital‑shake the plate at 500 rpm for 2 min, then incubate at room temperature for 10 min.

steps.title: Read luminescence
steps.instruction: Read the plate for luminescence on the Biotek microplate reader.
